page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number at upper left, running head "EMBLEMA" centred, then a full-width title in capitals with a second line in italic. Centre: a woodcut engraving (emblem picture) with no text. Below the picture: a four-line italic verse, centred, with a Greek word in the second line. Bottom right: catchword-like signature word "SOLIDA" in small capitals.

main_text.l: Iudicis aduentu micat æthra, & cuncta tremiscit
Κτήσις, & ad sancti Iudicis ora stupet.
Qui vigilat fidens est parte beatus ab omni,
Ad dextram stabit, & cœlica regna petet.

page.notes: The woodcut shows Christ enthroned on a rainbow-like arc above clouds, holding a lily branch and a sword, with an hourglass hanging below him; below, the dead rise and are sorted, the blessed to the left and the damned driven into a fiery mouth of Hell at the right. The second verse line begins with Greek "Κρίσις" (judgement), printed as "Κτήσις" in the scan image; the Greek is uncertain and marked here: Κρίσις[?]. The catchword "SOLIDA" at the foot right is the signature/catchword of the gathering and is given as a foot line.
